originalTitle: Social Security COLA for 2027 may be 3.5% to 3.6%, new estimates show — the highest in 3 years
summary: New government inflation data points to a higher Social Security cost-of-living adjustment for 2027. Here's what experts estimate the change may be.
content:
The Social Security cost-of-living adjustment for 2027 may be around 3.5% to 3.6%, according to new estimates based on government inflation data — which would push the annual adjustment to the highest in three years.

In 2026, around 75 million Social Security and Supplemental Security Income beneficiaries saw a 2.8% boost to their benefits, according to the Social Security Administration.

The Social Security COLA for 2027 may be 3.5%, factoring in the latest consumer price index data released on Friday, according to Mary Johnson, an independent Social Security and Medicare policy analyst. In August, Johnson had estimated the COLA may be 3.4%.

Johnson said how the projected COLA might change will depend on volatile oil prices. Oil prices have had a significant impact on inflation since the Iran war began.

Read more CNBC personal finance coverage

The Senior Citizens League now projects a 3.5% Social Security COLA, down from the 3.6% increase it had estimated last month. That latest estimate would increase average monthly benefit checks by $67.90, according to the nonpartisan senior group.

Meanwhile, AARP now forecasts a 3.6% Social Security COLA for 2027, which would increase the average retired worker's benefit by $75 per month, the nonprofit representing Americans age 50 and over said on Friday. That is up from the 3.5% COLA that AARP had estimated in August.

In the past decade, the Social Security COLA has ranged from 0% in 2016 to 8.7% in 2023, the highest increase in four decades, due to rising inflation. The COLA has averaged about 3.1% over the past 10 years, the Social Security Administration said in October.

When to expect Social Security 2027 COLA news

The official Social Security COLA for 2027 will include one more month of government inflation data. The Social Security Administration typically announces the following year's change in October.

The Social Security COLA is determined by the percentage increase in third-quarter inflation data from the prior year to the current year.

The calculation is based on a subset of the consumer price index, known as the Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers, or CPI-W. The CPI-W in August increased 3.5% over the past 12 months, according to data released by the Bureau of Labor Statistics on Friday.

The broader consumer price index was up 3.4% over the past 12 months as the cost of goods and services climbed in August.
chineseTitle: 新估计显示，2027 年社会保障 COLA 可能为 3.5% 至 3.6%——为 3 年来最高水平
chineseSummary: 新的政府通胀数据表明 2027 年社会保障生活成本将进行更高的调整。以下是专家对可能发生的变化的估计。
chineseContent:
根据政府通胀数据的最新估计，2027 年的社会保障生活成本调整可能约为 3.5% 至 3.6%，这将使年度调整达到三年来的最高水平。

据社会保障管理局称，到 2026 年，约 7500 万社会保障和补充保障收入受益人的福利增加了 2.8%。

独立社会保障和医疗保险政策分析师玛丽·约翰逊 (Mary Johnson) 表示，考虑到周五发布的最新消费者价格指数数据，2027 年的社会保障 COLA 可能为 3.5%。 8月份，约翰逊曾预计COLA可能为3.4%。

约翰逊表示，预计的可乐可能如何变化将取决于油价的波动。自伊朗战争爆发以来，油价对通胀产生了重大影响。

阅读更多 CNBC 个人理财报道

老年人联盟目前预计社会保障 COLA 的增幅为 3.5%，低于上个月预计的 3.6% 的增幅。据无党派高级团体称，最新估计将使每月平均福利支票增加 67.90 美元。

与此同时，代表 50 岁及以上美国人的非营利组织周五表示，AARP 目前预测 2027 年社会保障 COLA 的比例将达到 3.6%，这将使退休工人每月的平均福利增加 75 美元。这高于 AARP 在 8 月份估计的 3.5% 可乐。

在过去十年中，由于通货膨胀不断上升，社会保障COLA从2016年的0%上升到2023年的8.7%，这是四十年来的最高增幅。社会保障管理局 10 月份表示，过去 10 年 COLA 的平均利率约为 3.1%。

2027 年社会保障 COLA 新闻何时发布

2027 年官方社会保障 COLA 将包括一个月以上的政府通胀数据。社会保障管理局通常会在十月份宣布次年的变化。

社会保障COLA是根据去年第三季度通胀数据与今年相比的增长百分比来确定的。

该计算基于消费者价格指数的一个子集，称为城市工资收入者和文职人员消费者价格指数，或 CPI-W。美国劳工统计局周五公布的数据显示，8 月份 CPI-W 在过去 12 个月中上涨了 3.5%。

随着 8 月份商品和服务成本的攀升，过去 12 个月更广泛的消费者价格指数上涨了 3.4%。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
